name: Skeleton Representation for Articulated NeRF
definition: A method to encode human shape and pose using a skeleton representation that defines connectivity and static bone lengths via a rest pose of 3D joint locations, allowing dynamics to be modeled via per-frame relative rotations and global positions.
summary: Skeleton Representation for Articulated NeRF encodes human motion by mapping query points to local bone coordinates via forward kinematics, distinguishing itself by replacing SMPL mesh topology with a pure skeletal hierarchy.
